episodes.description: Space technologist Robbie Schingler cofounded a satellite company that images the whole planet every day, making visible changes on Earth. Now he asks: Can we close the gap between seeing a crisis coming and actually stopping it? Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
